newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks little changed in early morning.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks little changed in early morning.

text.p: Tokyo stocks opened little changed on Wednesday, as a Wall Street rally overnight and the stable yen supported the market while profit-taking pressure capped the upside, brokers said.
As of 0015 GMT, the key Nikkei 225 average was up 10.38 points or 0.06 percent at 18,481.13. Its March futures were unchanged at 18,500.
